edits.headline: Nepal holds day of mourning after floods kill more than 1,300
edits.subheadline: About 5,000 people were still missing in Nepal and Tibet, the Associated Press reported.
editorialBody: Nepal held a national day of mourning on September 7 for more than 1,300 people killed in floods in Nepal and Tibet, the Associated Press reported. Flags were lowered at government offices, and about 5,000 people were still missing, according to Nepal's disaster management agency.

Police in Telangana arrested two opposition Bharat Rashtra Samithi members of the state legislative council, Tata Madhu and Naveen Kumar Reddy, over alleged derogatory remarks about Assembly Speaker Gaddam Prasad Kumar, ANI reported on ThePrint.

The Alternative for Germany won 43.8% of the vote in the Saxony-Anhalt state election on September 6, according to preliminary final results, NPR reported. The party fell just short of an absolute majority.
Protests in Albania against a resort project linked to Jared Kushner reached their 100th day, Al Jazeera reported.
